operations.title: Integral norm homology has universal Smith form
operations.statement: For every finite group G of order d>1 and commutative ring R, the norm-side homology of the two-periodic complex from T^2=dT is isomorphic as an R-module to (R/dR)^(d-2). Over Z its Smith form has one unit relation and d-2 invariant factors equal to d.
operations.scope: Underlying coefficient module of the regular group-ring correspondence; finer G-action and physical realization are not asserted.

operations.title: S3 integral simultaneous-bad-prime control
operations.procedure: Use the augmentation basis g-1 for the five-dimensional ideal of Z[S3]. Modulo 6I, the relation 6*1-nu is the primitive all-ones vector. Quotienting leaves four invariant factors equal to 6.
operations.expected_result: H_T for S3 is (Z/6)^4 and reduces to dimension four in both characteristics two and three. Any different Smith factors falsify the claim.
